title: Vapouriz Premium FUSE Dual Coil Tank
description: Our bestselling FUSE Dual Coil Clearomizer is an excellent choice for any vaper, whether you're an experienced user or a newcomer. Compatible with some of our most popular hardware, the dual coil is located at the bottom of the Clearomizer, helping the coil to stay continuously saturated with e-liquid, giving more flavour and guarding against 'burnt' hits.
